'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021–2022 Iraqi political crisis|Iraqi political crisis]]
**[[2022 Baghdad clashes]]
***The death toll from the clashes in [[Baghdad]] between [[Shia Islam in Iraq|Iraqi Shia]] cleric [[Muqtada al-Sadr]]'s supporters and security forces increases to 23, with all of those killed being supporters of Sadr. 380 others are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-62719497 (BBC News)]
*Iran captures an American unmanned ship before releasing it. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/us-navy-says-iran-seized-later-let-go-of-american-sea-drone/2022/08/30/c045cf4e-2879-11ed-a90a-fce4015dfc8f_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Allied Democratic Forces]] militants kill at least 40 people in a series of raids on several villages in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. At least 76 others are kidnapped by the group. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/militants-kill-least-40-villagers-east-congo-attacks-2022-08-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**The [[Republic of China Armed Forces|Taiwanese military]] fire warning shots at a [[China|Chinese]] drone flying over islands in the [[Kinmen]] region. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/4642419 (''Taiwan News'')]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**A police chief is killed by suspected members of the [[Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters]] in [[Maguindanao]], [[the Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/police-philippines-ef66d416eafd3fde14fdba1336e2b203 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Sixteen people are killed and eight others are injured in a traffic collision between a truck and a minibus in [[Khuzestan province]], [[Iran]]. [http://english.news.cn/20220830/7c84352be7134819b7f75bfffc6db078/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)]
*A [[South African Police Service]] plane crashes at [[Rand Airport]] in [[Johannesburg]], killing all five passengers and critically injuring the pilot. [https://www.iol.co.za/news/south-africa/gauteng/five-killed-as-saps-plane-crashes-at-rand-airport-pilot-critically-injured-f1564e3d-97fb-4b72-895c-1d0269ec687a (''Independent Online'')] [https://www.sabcnews.com/sabcnews/five-killed-in-police-aircraft-crash-at-rand-airport-in-gauteng/ (SABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[China]] announces new [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]]s in several cities following a series of [[COVID-19]] outbreaks across the country. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/china-covid-lockdown-back-amid-fresh-cases-dalian-hebei-beijing/ (CBS News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Solomon Islands–United States relations]]
**The [[Embassy of the United States, Canberra|United States Embassy in Canberra]] says that the government of [[Solomon Islands]] will place a moratorium on [[United States Navy|US Navy]] ships entering its ports amid deteriorating relations between the two countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/solomon-islands-ban-us-navy-ships-ports-us-embassy-2022-08-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Papua conflict]]
**Six [[Indonesian Army|Indonesian soldiers]] are arrested for killing four [[Indigenous people of New Guinea|indigenous Papuan people]] and mutilating their bodies in [[Timika]] eight days ago. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62727954 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Portugal]]'s health minister [[Marta Temido]] resigns after emergency services closures. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/portugals-health-minister-resigns-after-emergency-services-closures-2022-08-30/ (Reuters)]
